data.agent.yaml:
apiVersion: okoscope.io/v1alpha1
kind: AgentConfiguration
server:
  endpoint: "https://grpc.okoscope.com:443"
  developmentPlaintext: false
identity:
  nodeName: overridden-by-downward-api
  clusterName: "aliens"
scope:
  workloads:
    - applicationCredentialFile: /var/run/secrets/okoscope/applications/0
      namespace: "okoscope-quickstart"
      kind: "Deployment"
      name: "quickstart-demo"
observation:
  files:
    enabled: false
    excludePaths: []
    includePaths: []
    operations:
    - create
    - modify
    - delete
    - rename
  network:
    accept: true
    connect: true
    dns:
      enabled: false
      tcp: true
      udp: true
    listen: true
    maxAcceptedEventsPerSecond: 25
  processExec: true
  processExit: true
  syscalls: []
safety:
  batchSize: 256
  maxApplicationStreams: 32
  maxEventsPerSecond: 1000
  queueCapacity: 4096
